definition_zh: 预防性的；预防的；起预防作用的东西
definition_en: intended to stop something bad from happening, or a thing that does this
core_image: 门窗尚未关好，就先在门前加一道挡板
scene: 医生嘱咐中年人每年体检一次，把问题挡在发生之前。The doctor told the middle aged patient to have a yearly check as a preventative step.
sceneCN: 这里 preventative 是「预防性的、起预防作用的」（第 1 个义项：用来阻止坏事发生）；句意：医生嘱咐中年人每年体检一次，把问题挡在发生之前。

pos.zh: 预防性的；起预防作用的

derivatives.zh: 同根名词：预防，比形容词更常用，如 fire prevention
基础动词：阻止，挡住；形容词正由此长出
省去 -at- 的短形，医学与正式文件中更常见
-able 后缀：可预防的，常修饰事故与疾病
-er 后缀：阻止者；航海索具中的制止索

senses.title: Intended to stop harm
senses.definition: acting in advance so that an illness, accident, or problem never starts
senses.definitionCN: 提前行动，使疾病、事故或问题根本不发生
senses.example: Vaccination is a cheap preventative measure.
senses.exampleCN: 接种疫苗是一种便宜的预防措施。
senses.why: The Latin verb praevenire meant to come before, so a preventative step is one that arrives ahead of the trouble.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语动词 praevenire 意为「先来」，所以预防性的措施就是赶在麻烦之前到达的那一步。

senses.title: Preventive medicine
senses.definition: medical care that keeps people healthy rather than treating them once they are ill
senses.definitionCN: 让人保持健康、而不是等人生病再治的医疗
senses.example: Spending on preventative care has risen sharply.
senses.exampleCN: 预防性医疗的支出大幅上升。
senses.why: Medicine liked the longer form early, so preventative became the standard adjective in public health writing.
senses.whyCN: 医学界很早就爱用这个较长的形式，所以 preventative 成了公共卫生写作里的标准形容词。

senses.title: A preventative remedy
senses.titleCN: 预防药；预防措施（名词用法）
senses.definition: a medicine, device, or step taken as a protection against something
senses.definitionCN: 用来防患某种疾病的药物、装置或做法
senses.example: This lotion is a preventative against sunburn.
senses.exampleCN: 这种乳液是一种防晒伤的预防用品。
senses.why: Because the adjective describes things that head off harm, English could shift it into a noun naming the remedy itself.
senses.whyCN: 因为形容词描述的是「提前挡灾之物」，英语就把它转成名词，直接指那样药或那样措施。

intro.en: Preventative grows from Latin prae- before and venire to come, with the same stem as prevent and prevention.
intro.cn: preventative 来自拉丁语 prae-（在前）与 venire（来），与 prevent、prevention 共享同一词干。

items.en: Prae- meant before or in front, the same prefix that gives predict and precaution.
items.cn: prae- 意为「在前、在……前面」，predict 与 precaution 也用这个前缀。

items.en: Venire meant to come, and it supplies the vent- seen in intervene and event.
items.cn: venire 意为「来」，intervene 与 event 里的 vent- 都来自它。

items.en: Praevenire meant to come before someone, and so to anticipate or forestall them.
items.cn: praevenire 意为「先于某人来到」，因此引申为预先、抢先拦下。

items.en: Old French prevenir kept both the arrival first and the hindering that follows from it.
items.cn: 古法语 prevenir 同时保留「先到」与「因先到而阻挡」两层意思。

items.en: English added the suffix -ative to prevent, and preventative appeared beside the shorter preventive.
items.cn: 英语给 prevent 加上 -ative 词尾，preventative 与较短的 preventive 并肩出现。

items.en: Preventive is older and still preferred in formal writing, but preventative thrives in medicine and everyday speech, and no dictionary treats it as an error.
items.cn: 较短的 preventive 出现更早，正式写作仍偏爱它；但 preventative 在医学和口语里很活跃，词典并不把它当作错误。

note.en: Preventative is the long twin of preventive, so it sits beside that word by form, and near precautionary, prophylactic, and protective by meaning.
note.cn: preventative 是 preventive 的长形孪生词，所以形式上与它相邻；意义上靠近 precautionary、prophylactic 与 protective。

entries.definition: the shorter form of the same adjective and noun, older and commoner in formal writing
entries.definitionCN: 同一形容词与名词的短形，历史更久，正式写作里更常见

entries.definition: the act of stopping something before it happens
entries.definitionCN: 预防；防止，与形容词同根

entries.definition: to stop something from happening
entries.definitionCN: 阻止；防止，是这两个形式的共同动词

entries.definition: done in advance to avoid possible danger
entries.definitionCN: 预防性的；防范性的，强调事先小心

entries.definition: designed to stop disease rather than cure it
giving protection against damage or harm
entries.definitionCN: 保护性的，强调挡在事物外面

normalIntro.en: Preventative is prevent plus -ative, so it labels anything that acts before the harm arrives.
normalIntro.cn: preventative 就是 prevent 加 -ative，所以它标注一切赶在伤害到来之前行事的东西。

normal.en: The -ative ending marks an adjective of purpose, as in creative or communicative.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ative 标示「有……用途」的形容词，creative、communicative 也是如此。

normal.en: Drop -at- and you get preventive, the form dictionaries list first.
normal.cn: 去掉中间的 -at- 就得到 preventive，这是词典最先列出的形式。

normal.en: The verb prevent contains vene, from Latin to come: to prevent is to come ahead of trouble.
normal.cn: 动词 prevent 里的 vene 来自拉丁语「来」：prevent 就是赶在麻烦前头到达。

normal.en: Preventative maintenance means fixing a machine before it breaks.
normal.cn: preventative maintenance 指在机器坏掉之前先修好它。

normal.en: Prevention is the noun of the same family, as in prevention is better than cure.
normal.cn: prevention 也属同一词族，对应那句「预防胜于治疗」。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden board nailed over a doorway before the flood comes.
abstract.cn: 想象洪水到来之前，就有人把木板钉在门口。

abstract.en: Picture a yearly health check that finds nothing at all.
abstract.cn: 想象每年体检一次，结果什么都查不出来。

abstract.en: Picture a small bottle of lotion standing between bare skin and the sun.
abstract.cn: 想象一小瓶乳液挡在裸露皮肤和太阳之间。

examples.en: The school took preventative steps to stop the flu from spreading.
examples.cn: 学校采取了预防措施，防止流感蔓延。

examples.en: Many doctors prefer the word preventive, though preventative is widely accepted.
examples.cn: 许多医生偏爱 preventive 这个词，不过 preventative 也被广泛接受。

examples.en: Antiseptic cream is a common preventative against infection.
examples.cn: 抗菌药膏是常见的防感染用品。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑来防它」——祸事扑来之前先把它挡住，就是预防；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 prae-（在前）+ venire（来）→ praevenire（先到、抢先拦下）→ 古法语 prevenir → 英语 prevent ＋ 形容词词尾 -ative → preventative，核心义「赶在坏事发生之前动手」。

sensesIntro.en: Preventative begins as an adjective for steps taken in advance, leans toward medical care, and then becomes a noun for the remedy itself.
sensesIntro.cn: preventative 先是形容「提前做的措施」，偏向医疗语境，随后又转成名词，直接指那剂药或那项措施。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a board nailed over a doorway before the flood comes.
core.cn: 核心意象：洪水到来之前，木板已经钉在门口。

branches.en: Steps taken in advance form the general sense.
branches.cn: 提前采取的措施构成一般义项。

branches.en: Health care that keeps illness away is the medical sense.
branches.cn: 让人不生病、保持健康的医疗是医学义项。

branches.en: Naming the remedy itself turns the adjective into a noun.
branches.cn: 直接指那剂药或那项措施，就是形容词转名词。

branches.en: A yearly check and a sealed doorway are both things done before the trouble.
branches.cn: 年度体检与封好的门口，都是赶在麻烦之前做的事。

branches.en: A vaccine is both preventative care and a preventative in its own right.
branches.cn: 疫苗既是预防性医疗，本身也是一件预防用品。

intro.en: Preventative is Latin prae- before plus venire to come, then the English suffix -ative; its short twin preventive simply drops the -at-.
intro.cn: preventative 由拉丁前缀 prae-（在前）、动词 venire（来）与英语词尾 -ative 构成；短形 preventive 只是省掉了中间的 -at-。

latinIntro.en: Latin praevenire joined prae-, in front, with venire, to come, and meant both to arrive first and to hinder.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 praevenire 把 prae-（在前）与 venire（来）结合，既指先到，也指阻拦。

items.example: The prefix prae- puts the action ahead of the event.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 prae- 把这个动作放在事件之前。

items.example: Venire gives the coming in intervene and convenience.
items.exampleCN: venire 为 intervene 与 convenience 提供「来」。

items.example: The root vent- also appears in event and adventure.
items.exampleCN: 词根 vent- 也出现在 event 与 adventure 中。

items.example: Praevenire is the Latin source of prevent.
items.exampleCN: praevenire 是 prevent 的拉丁来源。

items.example: Prevent is the base verb of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: prevent 是整个词族的基动词。

items.example: The suffix -ative forms preventative and talkative.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ative 构成 preventative 与 talkative。

items.meaning: acting to stop something before it starts
items.example: Preventive is the older short form of the adjective.
items.exampleCN: preventive 是这一形容词更早的短形。

items.example: The suffix -tion forms prevention.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -tion 构成 prevention。

items.example: The suffix -able forms preventable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -able 构成 preventable。

items.meaning: a person or thing that does
items.example: The suffix -er forms preventer.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 构成 preventer。
